abstract: Four cases of yolk sac tumor of the testis and ovary were examined by histochemistry, immunohistochemistry, and electron microscopy, and particular attention was directed toward the close relationship between hyaline globules and alpha fetoprotein (AFP). The hyaline globules were easily identified as eosinophilic globular structures located in the cytoplasm of the tumor cell as well as in the extracellular space. They were considered to be of glycoprotein in nature by their histochemical staining property. By an indirect immunoperoxidase method, the majority of intracytoplasmic hyaline globules were positive for AFP. Electronmicroscopically, the hyaline globules appeared as electron dense bodies with no limiting membranes. They were divided into two types by their electron density and inner structure: one is an electron high dense body consisting of homogeneous or fine granular materials and the other is a moderately electron dense body composed of fine filamentous structures similar to the basement membrane materials. It is suggested that the former corresponds with the AFP positive hyaline globules produces by the tumor cells of visceral type, while the latter represents the AFP negative globules formed by the cells of parietal type in non-neoplastic counterparts.
abstract_ja: 精巣および卵巣の卵黄嚢腫瘍4例を、組織化学、免疫組織化学、電子顕微鏡を用いて検討し、硝子様小体とαフェトプロテイン(AFP)との密接な関係に着目した。硝子様小体は、細胞質内だけでなく細胞外間隙にも、好酸性の球状構造として容易に同定された。組織化学的染色性から、糖蛋白性と考えられた。間接免疫ペルオキシダーゼ法では、細胞質内の硝子様小体の大半がAFP陽性であった。電子顕微鏡では、硝子様小体は限界膜を持たない電子密度の高い小体として認められた。電子密度と内部構造により2型に分類された。一つは均質または微細顆粒状の物質からなる電子密度の高い小体であり、もう一つは基底膜様物質に似た微細線維状構造からなる中等度の電子密度を持つ小体であった。前者は内臓型の腫瘍細胞が産生するAFP陽性の硝子様小体に対応し、後者は非腫瘍性の壁側型細胞が形成するAFP陰性の小体を表すと考えられる。
